task: Extend the Emitter class in src/events.mjs with two capabilities the pipeline runtime needs. (1) once(event, handler): registers a handler that runs at most one time; it must be deregistered BEFORE it is invoked, so a reentrant emit of the same event from inside the handler cannot fire it again, and off(event, handler) called with the original handler function must cancel a pending once registration. (2) Snapshot emit semantics: emit(event, payload) invokes exactly the handlers registered at the moment the emit starts — a handler added by another handler during that emit runs only on later emits, and a handler removed by another handler during that emit is still invoked for the current one. emit must keep returning the number of handlers it invoked, and the existing on/off/listenerCount API and its validation must keep working unchanged. Update or add tests for the new behavior and verify with the repository test suite.
